name: lón láith
text: lón láith names the light-beam that projects from Cúchulainn's forehead when he goes into battle. MacKillop records the Irish term laoich with the gloss champions light. The full record of the warrior's battle-light sits under the headword Cúchulainn.

attributes.attribute: Irish term for the champions' battle-light; cites Cúchulainn as the canonical headword

okr.objective: lón láith is a MacKillop headword for Cúchulainn's battle-light.
key_results: Signpost cites Cúchulainn as the canonical headword.
